#!/usr/bin/env python3
import re
import os

# Dateien zum Bearbeiten
files_to_fix = [
    'lib/services/crunchyroll_service.dart',
    'lib/main.dart',
]

for file_path in files_to_fix:
    if not os.path.exists(file_path):
        print(f"⚠️  {file_path} nicht gefunden")
        continue
    
    with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = f.read()
    
    # Ersetze alle print()-Aufrufe mit if (_debugPrint) print()
    # Pattern: "    print(" oder "      print(" etc (mit Einrückung)
    content = re.sub(r'^(\s+)print\(', r'\1if (_debugPrint) print(', content, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    
    with open(file_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(content)
    
    print(f"✓ Updated {file_path}")

print("\n✓ Done - all print() calls are now wrapped with if (_debugPrint)")
